scientific_integrity: Two different Fano-plane constructions independently reproduce the exact minimum-set census, five-basis coverage and containment profiles, and relocation metrics. The complete 11-orbit computation is separately exhaustively verified by the cyclic-incidence program. All dependencies are embedded.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact theorem for the fourteen-vertex Heawood graph only; not for general projective planes.
Numerical statements are established by complete executable finite certificates; no all-order generalization is claimed.
Unindexed equivalent historical computations could exist; independent scholarly audit has not been performed.
title: A one-landmark gap and connected edge-sensor mobility on the Heawood graph
